notes.title: v 1.0.1 Menu Window Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with the menu system where it would ignore the monitor the game was on when deciding it's position.

notes.title: Major Demo Content Update + Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello all! 



I want to thank you all again for looking into my little game! I've been hard at work improving the game and getting everything ship shape and ready for release! 



Speaking of, the official release date for My Favorite Coworker is the 24th of September! The final version of the game will include achievements, a device customization, and 2 other pet evolutionary lines to work through!



To tide you over until then, I have a host of updates I've made to the demo to improve gameplay! Please view the changelog below:

Added a mood display system to give the player more insight into how well they are doing. 

Updated Evolution Sequence to show a special display and wait for player input before continuing. 

Pet's can now be named.

Food can rot if it's left out too long.

Pet's can gain special status conditions when receiving trauma, including conditions like Stinky, Hungry, Overstimulated, and Anxious.



I hope you all continue to enjoy My Favorite Coworker and are as excited as I am for it's official release next month!



-Aidan M.W. Barrett

notes.title: MFC Demo Hotfix v0.4.2
notes.notes:
Hello all! I have worked on and fixed a handful of issues that were discovered after the demo released. On top of this stay tuned for an official release date being made public soon!



Game Changes

Improved Guess! minigame to have a high reward to account for random stat improvement 

Pet will now look in the direction chosen in Guess! minigame

Improved game time modification options and added giga fast/slow modes 



Bug Fixes

Fixed issue with device minimization causing it to disappear when in any corner other than the bottom right 

Fixed issue with device minimization animation snapping when minimizing from the top corners. 

Prevented scenario in which the pet will attempt to eat air forever. 

Fixed issue with dialog windows opening off screen

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello all! I am happy to announce that the demo for My Favorite Coworker is finally ready! You can access it right now on the store page to enjoy your time with Buh!

There are a few known issues that I am currently working on that will be fixed by the end of the day, future content updates and announcements will also always be posted here as well!



Have a great day and enjoy meeting your favorite coworker!
